title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning
description:
Roku pioneered TV streaming and continues to shape the future of streaming through innovation. The Roku Channel has us well-positioned to help shape the future of streaming. Continued success relies on investing in the Roku Cloud TV Platform, so we deliver high quality streaming TV experience at a global scale.

You will be part of the Roku Content Management System and Tools Engineering team, playing a key role in developing the next generation platform for Media Quality Control. This role involves developing an intelligent Content Quality Control platform which will power delightful experiences across all Roku TV touchpoints. This entails building sophisticated ML models to power our quality control workflows, ensuring quality and accuracy of key media attributes, including video, audio, and closed captions, for content featured on the Roku platform. As our content catalog continues to grow, the platform needs to be built for scalability, ensuring that our media consistently meets the highest standards of quality before reaching our audience. These systems are vital for powering critical functions like Search and Recommendation on the Roku Platform. Your work will have a direct impact on millions of Roku users globally by ensuring high-quality media reaches the audience. Throughout, you'll collaborate with key stakeholders across various Roku engineering teams and take the lead in designing our content management system.

The ideal candidate will have endless curiosity and can pair a global mindset with locally relevant execution. You should be a gritty problem solver and self-starter who can drive programs with the product and commercial teams within Roku and across external strategic partner organizations. The successful candidate will display a balance of hard and soft skills, including the ability to respond quickly to changing business needs. This is an excellent role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility, thrives on having a critical business impact, able to make critical decisions and is excited to work on a core content pipeline component which is crucial for many streaming components at Roku.
What youll be doing
Building and owning the next generation of media quality control platforms and other algorithms/systems that create high quality and unique experiences for millions of Roku users.
Design and develop machine learning models and computer vision algorithms to automate the quality control process for video and audio, ensuring media quality by analyzing attributes such as frame rate consistency, color accuracy, noise detection, and loudness normalization across an expanding content catalog.
Create and optimize tools for evaluating closed captioning accuracy, synchronization, and quality.
Researching and developing advanced AI algorithms, including Vision Models for visual content analysis, and enhancing the Media Understanding Models.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product, engineering, and content operations, to align technical solutions with business needs.
Participate in architecture discussions, influence product roadmap, and take ownership and responsibility over new projects.
Manage individual project priorities, deadlines and deliverables with limited supervision.
Were excited if you have
4+ years of experience applying Machine Learning and Generative AI to real-world, large-scale problems, with a strong foundation in algorithm design and computer science fundamentals
Deep understanding of modern deep learning architectures (e.g., transformers), training paradigms, fine-tuning techniques, loss functions, and optimization methods
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java, along with hands-on experience using ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn
Expertise in computer vision, including deep learning models for video/image analysis, with practical experience using OpenCV and FFmpeg for media processing tasks
Experience building scalable data processing pipelines and deploying ML solutions on cloud platforms such as AWS (preferred), GCP, or Azure
Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Collaborative mindset, with the ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments
Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or a related field; a Ph.D. is a plus
